tasks.title: E07 in full from its design
tasks.brief: You are the only coder on epic E07 (Oximeter and clinical device adapters). Implement it in full from its product brief docs/product/tdd/E07.md and docs/SYSTEM.md (its module, ports and seams; this epic has no design): every section, and every R, V and D of its acceptance matrix with a test, including end to end tests on the real stack. docs/build/E07/PLAN.md and ticket_tasks in docs/build/E07/tasks.json describe one split of this work with briefs, tests and gates: use them as a guide and checklist; the design and docs/SYSTEM.md win where they differ. Build in this order: domain, application, adapters, api, user interface, and run your tests as you go. If an epic you depend on has no code yet, code against its port protocol and the kernel fakes (docs/SYSTEM.md section 10).

ticket_tasks.title: Validated oximeter and clinical import source boundary
ticket_tasks.brief:
Read AGENTS.md, docs/SYSTEM.md and docs/requests/COORDINATOR-DECISIONS.md first, in that order, then all reads. This brief is for a fresh-session coder. E07 has no design, request file or design reviews at planning time. Implement the product brief sections Product contract and Required work and acceptance, plus PLAN.md Design decisions and the task-specific obligations below. Never infer a missing design section. SYSTEM 4.3/6.1 owns the three E07 adapter directories and its eval scenario directory. Recheck the tree and every docs/build/*/tasks.json before creating anything; edit only owned_paths. At planning time hub/, ui/, eval/, all three adapter projects and general generated contracts are absent. Existing config/contracts pharmacy artifacts and the root engine project are read only. No git commands, design edits, em/en dashes or spaced hyphen dash.

SYSTEM 5.1 through 5.12 are authoritative: IdFactory/require_id; Clock, TimeInput, ClockSegment/ClockSegments, ClockCorrections/NormalizedTime; MissionClock; Unit/Quantity/WireQuantity/WireUnitConverter; ProblemError/StorageUnavailable and the generated ErrorEnvelope mapping; ConfigReleaseReader/ReleaseHandle; UnitOfWork/ReadSnapshot and events/audiences; CommandIdentity/IdempotencyStore/CommandReceipts/AcceptedReceipt/ResultVisibility; whole-envelope audit; HealthState, TaskQueue/TaskRunner, EvaluationIsolation; HubSettings/SettingSpec; ModuleRegistry and startup order. Use their exact signatures at their owning hub boundary. SYSTEM 6.2 workers import generated crew_health.contracts_gen only, never hub kernel/features/platform/app as an accidental dependency. Do not copy a kernel type or invent a worker clock, queue, transaction, ledger or retry mechanism to bridge this gap: PLAN P-E07-3 requires the shared worker-safe binding. Hub producers still use SYSTEM 5.7/5.8/5.10; E07 does not become a hub module. SYSTEM 6.4/6.5 and 8.1/8.3/8.6 govern import boundaries, generated effective contracts, seams, current per-object/field privacy and durability. D1/D3/D5/D6/D7/D12/D13/D17 and Q8 apply. Optional devices/model/ground never gate direct manual care or emergency entry.

E01/E02/E05 are hard dependencies (SYSTEM 9); E27 is optional at runtime. Absent providers are consumed through published application protocols and E01 kernel.testing for unit work under SYSTEM 10, never invented implementations. CapabilityQueries, MeasurementCommands and ObservationCommands are names/owners in SYSTEM 4.2, not complete callable signatures. R-E05-1/2/3/4/5/6 and R-E01-1/17 remain pending. In particular no approved complete source-assignment/producer-proof/physical dispatch/minimal adapter receipt currently exists. Do not implement request proposals as accepted interfaces or use Observation.context/quality_notes as proof. PLAN P-E07-1/2/3/4 must be decided and delivered before their affected bindings; have the coordinator file them in docs/requests/E07.md because your paths exclude that file. Read the resulting canonical decisions, effective generated schemas and provider tests before implementation. A missing prerequisite blocks that clause, not an invitation to guess, omit a check or mark a safe-disabled feature done.

Existing wire boundary: recordAttempt is POST /v1/measurement-requests/{request_id}/attempts (docs/product/api/openapi.yaml:4936), adapterToken, Idempotency-Key, Config-Release and correlation headers, generated AttemptCreate (requests.schema.json:781). Its sequence, started_at, ended_at, outcome success/failed/rejected, observations, failure_reason and quality_notes preserve their exact schema requirements. Use approved effective additions for acquisition/generation/producer evidence and minimal receipt only after they exist. E05 owns the transaction and E01 appends observations in that UoW; E07 writes no clinical table, migration, event or public Job. recordObservation, POST /v1/observations, generated ObservationCreate (openapi.yaml:4410; requests.schema.json:576) is E01's direct manual path, rendered by E05/E03. It preserves patient_id, code, value/unit, observed_at, origin_mode, actual acquisition_method, device_id, nullable episode and permitted context/body_region/supersedes/request link. Authenticated operator attribution is resolved by E01/E02, never invented in the closed input. Do not use the habitat AdapterReadingBatch or /v1/adapters/{adapter_id}/readings for patient data. Generated Observation has numeric value, original/canonical units, separate patient/operator and provenance (observation.schema.json:1); a qualitative ECG finding cannot be encoded there. There is no current generated Device or AdapterManifest; their approved definitions are required under P-E07-1, never hand-written shared DTOs.

Tests first, with local IDs below and explicit R/V/D/invariant trace. Unit/property tests are hermetic with injected time/IDs, no network/wall clock/real devices. Generated configuration supplies inputs; independent primary-source expectations prove protocol and clinical golden cases. Test data files belong only in eval/scenarios/E07/, owned by T4; request assets from that author, do not write sample files in source packages. T4 can prepare assets before integration execution. Unit tests may generate values from scratch validated configuration without persisting datasets. LIVE/REPLAY/SIM use the same production decoder/sender and carry origin to the screen; only explicit fixture profiles load eval assets. No normal default, interpolation, clipping, NaN/infinity, sample fallback or blanket exception conversion. Never discard a real disagreeing reading. Missing, unknown, failed, rejected and stale remain distinguishable.

All queues/pages/batches/buffers/notifications/files/loops/retries/caches have named bounded settings; every I/O/process/BLE/HTTP call has a timeout. SYSTEM 5.11 supplies descriptors, not permission to choose clinical limits. Register the coordinator-approved worker descriptors and finite caps through its published mechanism; do not edit shared settings/schema/supervisor files. Domain content and words come from validated release documents/backend state, not code or adapter TOML defaults. Current kit-map.json and indicator-catalog.json describe capabilities/display, not clinical range/saturation/stuck/rate policy. E01's sourced observation policy and effective unit-mapping.json perform acceptance and UCUM conversion, preserving original quantities. Invalid configuration rejects atomically and retains last good; open acquisitions keep release/quality pins. Configuration never changes a safety level mapping or clears a warning.

Apply every relevant AGENTS 6 failure case: pre/post-write crash and power loss, duplicate/retried submissions, concurrent starts/cancels/clients, source restarts and clock corrections/mission boundaries, disk full, missing/corrupt configuration, partial/implausible/disagreeing readings, long hub/ground outage, absent/incapacitated subject and cross-crew privacy. Observation time never becomes arrival-time freshness. SYSTEM 5.2's same raw time in segments A/B remains distinct after restart; unknown/future/regressed time cannot clear safety state. Relative timeout/backoff/health duration uses shared elapsed semantics, explicit examination timestamps remain absolute. Keep original command key/body/target/parameters, sequence and evidence until durable authorized acknowledgment. Accept a 409 only with the exact matching accepted_command receipt of SYSTEM 5.8; a conflicting/revoked replay is not acceptance. Storage/I/O/integrity/authorization/configuration/input errors propagate and acknowledge nothing; only the hub's typed EvaluatorComputationFailure may isolate evaluation under D13. A late cancelled task may fail completion but must not erase genuine evidence before retained/quarantined ingest. Unknown physical state after restart never triggers blind recapture.

Done requires the task's positive and fault cases, gates, T4 real-stack counterpart, approved prerequisites, zero warnings, full critical decision conditions and honest evidence for hardware compatibility/calibration. Do not skip/xfail required tests or report an unavailable integration as passed. Every bug gets a failing test before its fix and the full epic suites rerun afterwards. Independent build review, green CI and coordinator AI-USE-LOG.md rows are also required for epic greenlight. Send defects outside owned_paths to the owning task/coordinator with a failing trace. No copy of another epic's module, configuration, parser acceptance policy, form or harness. Implementation gates listed here are obligations pending delivered project/toolchain support, not commands claimed to work in the current empty tree.

Build the clinical source-input boundary in adapters/oximeter/, including its project configuration, small pure decoders/mappers, documented hardware boundary, HTTP sender binding, tests and calibration/failure manual. The two source paths in this one package are the oximeter BLE input of E07-01 and generic clinical file input of E07-02; this is not a reusable device framework. Leave cuff to T2, thermometer to T3 and all real-stack scenario assets/execution to T4. Leave UI/manual forms to E05/E03, acceptance/storage to E01/E05, tokens/device identity to E02, kit computation to E27, private report handling/confirmation to E09 and process supervision to E20. Do not add a new hub package or another adapter project. The generic import's physical home is an explicit P-E07-2 decision prerequisite; if the coordinator requires another path, stop that clause and obtain revised task ownership before editing it.

Product sources: docs/product/tdd/E07.md:17 E07-01, :21 E07-02 and :25 E07-03; PRD:184 and :422; BUILD-CHARTER 2; DEPLOYMENT 3.4. Use bleak and the Bluetooth SIG Pulse Oximeter service 0x1822. Service discovery alone is not measurement decoding or compatibility evidence. Before enabling LIVE, record the actual paired model, protocol revision/primary specification and supported characteristics/status/timestamp semantics; record alternatives (standard profile versus documented vendor variant versus unavailable/manual), selected behavior, calibration metadata or explicit unknown, failure modes and rollback impact in the package manual. Protocol identifiers/byte-layout constants may encode the verified standard; device labels, acceptance ranges, cadence and units/mappings come from approved release content. No invented characteristic UUID, calibration correction or clinical tolerance. Without verified hardware, report decoder verification separately from unmeasured LIVE compatibility, with manual fallback still available.

Pulse/spo2 and pulse_oximeter are configured codes/identity examples from docs/product/api/examples/config/indicator-catalog.example.json:100 and docs/product/api/examples/kit-map.example.json:16, not code-held device inventory. Decode only fields actually present and usable under the verified status flags. Reject malformed/truncated/reserved/nonfinite data with typed reasons; a missing SpO2 never becomes zero, a normal pulse never supplies an ECG interpretation, and supported partial outcomes follow the approved E01/E05 policy without filling absent components. After disconnect/timeout, expose unavailable through approved E05 readiness/worker health; retain old values as historical, never current. A display-readable instrument can be entered through E01 manual_instrument with the real device_id and original observed time. A dead instrument has no new manual value. Camera disagreement never vetoes the real manual input (Q8).

Generic clinical file input uses BUILD-CHARTER 2's HL7 FHIR R4 4.0.1 interchange and SYSTEM 7.3's version/unit/provenance rules, not an ad hoc CSV, another report extractor or E29's exporter. P-E07-2 must publish the signed mapping, generated typed numeric/source-specific finding/interpretation contracts, BP component mapping, import identity and confirmation boundary before integration. Use those generated types verbatim; no guessed operationId, field, schema, table or local ConfirmedFinding clone. Numeric observations retain original units/times/device/source and actual imported method. Qualitative ECG and other instrument findings retain their source code, text/type, source document/span/hash, subject, examination time, confirmer and clinician interpretation attribution through the approved shape. Unknown/mismatched patient/date/unit or missing confirmation does not enter accepted context. Private reports use E09's confirmed path and privacy, not source bytes in an adapter spool/log. No model interpretation, fake ECG machine, hardware availability update or automatic CapabilityGap resolution results from importing a file. An historical report remains historical. Imported-versus-connected operation is explicit in the approved AdapterManifest; manifest truth is not inferred from a successful SIM test.

Write first: T-E07-OX-01 [R08, E07-01, V11] valid documented packet produces the expected attributed pulse/spo2 inputs; disconnect, missing radio and timeout produce unavailable/no invented value and preserve manual attribution. T-E07-OX-02 [E07-03, V15, AGENTS 2 input checks] property tests and independent byte-level golden cases for flags, optional components, bounds, truncation, wrong length/unit, nonfinite/sentinel/status values, unknown clock and insufficient sample history; never medical acceptance from indicator display bounds. T-E07-OX-03 [V08/V09/V13/V16/V25/V35, R25 invariant] binding/subject/token/generation/origin mismatch, cancel/late evidence, duplicate same-versus-changed sequence, receipt loss, crash/disk-full/restart and concurrent requests retain one logical result without remeasurement. Test sender behavior against the published boundary fake, not a fake hub acceptance policy. T-E07-OX-04 [R08/R26, E07-02, V18/V21/V38/V78] generated numeric instrument and typed ECG imports with confirmation/source attribution, duplicate import, malformed/oversized/deep files, unknown types, wrong subject/date/unit and historical data; no unconfirmed interpretation, false connected hardware or gap closure. T-E07-OX-05 [V75, AGENTS 1.1] a sourced nonsafety device label scratch edit changes emitted metadata and T4's UI, invalid update retains last good release and an open acquisition retains old pins. Do not edit a safety mapping. T-E07-OX-06 [R26/E07-03] manual lists actual protocol/calibration evidence, LIVE/import/REPLAY/SIM status, limits and honest unmeasured cases. T4 must execute every corresponding positive/failure path through actual HTTP/SQLite and mounted UI before this package receives acceptance.

Project toolchain configuration belongs to this directory under SYSTEM 6.2. Configure pytest/ruff/mypy and a worker import-linter contract in its own project configuration; it must reject every crew_health import except generated contracts, and must actually include all package files. P-E07-4 supplies the exact common guard/installer dependency binding rather than a permissive local stub. Tests and configuration are included in ruff/strict mypy scope. Coverage excludes tests and generated code; inventory every pure decoder, mapper and ingress decision in the independent branch/condition gate, so omitted source files cannot pass. Do not add fixtures or clinical configuration here. Package no import-time I/O, no unbounded reader, and no hidden device/model/ground requirement.
gates: uv run --project adapters/oximeter pytest -c adapters/oximeter/pyproject.toml -q adapters/oximeter --cov=adapters/oximeter --cov-branch --cov-report=json:/private/tmp/e07-oximeter-coverage.json --cov-fail-under=95
uv run --project adapters/oximeter ruff check adapters/oximeter
uv run --project adapters/oximeter ruff format --check adapters/oximeter
uv run --project adapters/oximeter mypy --config-file adapters/oximeter/pyproject.toml --strict adapters/oximeter
uv run --project adapters/oximeter lint-imports --config adapters/oximeter/pyproject.toml

T-E07-E2E-03 [R08, V13]: cancel before dispatch, during source capture and racing hub ingest, physical cannot-stop, stopped and lost ACK/unknown.
